decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API builds directly on the firm's messaging infrastructure, APIs and hosted communication expertise, and it has stayed on its own page for two years, so the firm can interpret its results and keep improving it at low cost.

The email-to-SMS gateway combines the firm's core email and messaging competences on its own cloud platform, so its absorptive capacity is high and it fits the strategy of integrated multichannel communication.
The SMS-to-email gateway is the natural counterpart to Product B and uses the same technology and knowledge base, so keeping it completes the channel integration at little extra cost.
